intervals.note: The MAGIX page (copyright 2023) says the experiments and the accelerator are currently under construction; the earliest dated statement is used as the start, not a construction-start date.
intervals.quote: The experiments, as well as the accelerator, are currently under construction.

website.quote: The MAGIX Collaboration is committed to perform, evaluate, and interpret cutting-edge electron scattering experiments at the high-intensity electron accelerator MESA in Mainz, Germany.

summary.plain: The collaboration, hosted by the Institute of Nuclear Physics at Mainz University, building the MAGIX electron-scattering experiment and DarkMESA at MESA.
summary.technical: MAGIX Collaboration: (a) the electron-scattering experiment MAGIX and (b) the beam-dump experiment DarkMESA; hosted by the Institute for Nuclear Physics of the University of Mainz; membership not recorded.
